app.name: Tekó
app.tagline: Brazilian tax law, as of the right date
app.description: Open-source assistant that answers questions about Brazilian tax law, citing the source and the wording in force on the reference date. Under construction.

common.disclaimer: A research aid; not professional advice.
common.license: Open source under the MIT license.

landing.title: Tax law, in the wording that applied on your date.
landing.lead: Tekó is an open-source assistant for questions about Brazilian tax law. Every answer is given for a tax period or reference date and cites the provision and the version it used.

demo.label: Illustrative sample answer
demo.question: What did art. 76, § 6, of the RCTE say in my tax period?
demo.answer: The answer uses the wording in force in 05/2008 and tags every statement with the citation it came from.
demo.changed: For 01/2010 the wording is different: the answer, the citation and the interval change together.

referenceDate.title: Reference date first
referenceDate.body: You set the tax period (for example, 03/2024) and the answer uses the wording in force at that time. If the rule changed within the period, Tekó tells you.

citations.title: Verifiable citations
citations.body: Every statement points to the provision, version and validity interval it relied on, with a link to the official source.

coverage.title: Declared coverage
coverage.body: Tekó states which rules and periods it knows. Outside that coverage, it declines instead of guessing.

corpus.title: Covered corpus
corpus.lead: Official sources, versioned and regularly checked against the original websites.

efdIcmsIpi.name: EFD ICMS/IPI
efdIcmsIpi.body: The Digital Tax Bookkeeping practical guide and its technical notes.

rcte.name: RCTE (Goiás)
rcte.body: Regulation of the Goiás State Tax Code (Decree No. 4,852/1997).

efdGo.name: EFD (Goiás)
efdGo.body: The state practical guide for EFD ICMS/IPI and the Goiás adjustment code tables.

sources.title: Nothing without a source
sources.body: Every statement in the answer points to a passage of the corpus. Without a passage to back it, it stays out.

refusal.title: Says when it does not know
refusal.body: A question outside the coverage gets a clear refusal, with the reason, instead of a guess.

advice.title: A research aid, not advice
advice.body: Tekó helps you look up the law. The decision and the responsibility stay with you and your accountant or lawyer.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.body: All the code, including the corpus ingestion, is public under the MIT license.

advice.question: Does Tekó replace an accountant or a lawyer?
advice.answer: No. It is a research aid and not professional advice. Always check the cited source before deciding.

referenceDate.question: Why do I need to set a date?
referenceDate.answer: Because tax law changes often. The same question can have different answers in 2008 and in 2010, and Tekó answers with the wording in force on your date.

cost.question: Is Tekó free?
cost.answer: Yes. The project is open source and runs on free services, so there is a daily question limit.

data.question: What happens to my questions?
data.answer: Questions go through a free AI provider, which may use them to improve its own models. Do not include personal data or confidential information.
